verdicts.reason: At this size I can't see any difference between the two; both are the same failed 320x50 layout. In both, the headline is squeezed into four lines that fill the whole height, the SOLSTICE logo and dark brand header are gone, and the body copy and legal text are a few pixels tall and unreadable. The CTA is a tiny pill crowded under the body copy, and the legal text takes up as much space as the message, so the hierarchy collapses.
